references.text: The leaders of the Philistines gathered to celebrate and offer sacrifices to their god Dagon, providing context for the crowd assembled in the temple.
Samson topples the pillars and kills everyone gathered in the building, including the three thousand on the roof mentioned in verse 27.
Mentions the five rulers of the Philistines (seranim), the same leaders who were gathered in the temple.
The five princes of the Philistines are also mentioned here, showing the political structure of the Philistines.
Refers to the five lords of the Philistine cities, the same leadership structure present in Dagon's temple.
Describes Dagon's temple where the Philistines gathered to worship, the same type of temple as in Judges 16.
